lines.zh: 我从水里爬上岸，拖着一身泥。
lines.en: I haul myself out of the water, coated in mud.

lines.zh: 我四条腿慢慢迈，尾巴划着地。
lines.en: I pace on four legs, my tail sweeping the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着沼泽边一点点挪。
lines.en: I creep along the swamp edge.
When I approach, the water ripples first.

lines.zh: 我一步一沉，泥没到膝盖。
lines.en: Each step sinks to my knees in mud.

lines.zh: 我转过头，朝你的方向走。
lines.en: I turn my head and walk your way.
Old scars run along my back.

lines.zh: 我穿过芦苇，芦苇一片片倒下。
lines.en: I push through the reeds and they fall flat.
I stop, then shift forward half a step.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在水里划出一道长的痕。
lines.en: My tail draws a long line through the water.
I follow behind you, slowly.

lines.zh: 我爬上岸时带起一摊脏水。
lines.en: I bring a pool of foul water up with me.
My belly rides very close to the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕着泥坑走，不去趟深水。
lines.en: I skirt the muddy pool, avoiding deep water.

lines.zh: 边走边闻，沼泽的味道最浓。
lines.en: Walking and sniffing, the swamp is thickest.

lines.zh: 我踩断了一根浮木，声音很闷。
lines.en: I break a floating log, and the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 我半截身子泡在水里，背脊露着。
lines.en: Half of me soaks in the water, only my back showing.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴泡在水里，像段烂木头。
lines.en: Mouth agape in the water, I look like rotten wood.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥上，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with my eyes open.

lines.zh: 我在等有东西走到岸边。
lines.en: I wait for something to come to the bank.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在水下慢慢摆。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly underwater.
The reeds hide half my back.
An insect lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我躺在那儿，像一段烂木。
lines.en: I lie there like a rotting log.
I blink slowly.
Mud drips off me.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候更像一块地。
lines.en: Still, I look more like terrain than an animal.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，盖住了我的背。
lines.en: The swamp mud covers my back.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让水面起小泡。
lines.en: My breathing bubbles the water.
I am waiting for the light to fail.
You stand on the bank; convenient.
I raise my eyes, only my eyes.
Your shadow falls at my mouth.
I am slow, and you are not fast.
You have walked a long way; tired?

lines.zh: 我的牙有一排，你看清楚。
lines.en: I have a full row of teeth; look closely.

lines.zh: 你站在泥地上，脚陷了吧。
lines.en: You stand on mud; your feet sinking?
I am in no hurry; the swamp is mine.
Your legs look strong.
I only look at you, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我甩了下尾巴，退进水里。
lines.en: I lash my tail and retreat into the water.
You cut my back and the hide splits.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面，只露我的眼。
lines.en: Only my eyes show above the swamp.
That makes me flatten lower.
Swamp gator with old teeth.
A layer of mud falls off me.
I retreat a little and stop again.
The wound is in the mud, and it stings.
You fight better than you look.
I open my jaws to warn you.
Something is moving; I smell it.
Put down the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 你每一步踩水，我都听得清楚。
lines.en: Every step you splash, I hear clearly.
Standing on the bank is foolish of you.
Raise the lamp; I am not afraid.
That smell of blood, I taste it first.
Retreat into the water; I like that more.
The closer you come to the bank, the better.
I shift toward the disturbance.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷在泥里，很好。
lines.en: Your boots are stuck in the mud; good.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你被顶进泥里。
lines.en: We collide and you are butted into the mud.
One sweep of my tail and you lose balance.

lines.zh: 我的皮很硬，你的刀滑了。
lines.en: My hide is hard and your blade slides.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞湿墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wet wall.
Shoved back, I retreat into the water.
My jaw strikes your knee.
Mud splashes everywhere at the impact.

lines.zh: 你踩到尾巴，我一甩抽在你腿上。
lines.en: You tread my tail; one swing rakes your leg.

lines.zh: 我把你推得往后退了三步。
lines.en: I push you back three steps.

lines.zh: 我们分开后，你身上全是泥。
lines.en: After we part, you are covered in mud.
There are no other gators in this swamp.
I lie in the water and do not think of that.
I think only of my next meal.
You stand too near to ask such a thing.
That belongs in the water, not here.
I flick my tail as an answer.
There is only one of me in this mud.
I have no interest in that.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，只剩眼睛在水面。
lines.en: I sink slowly until only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 你最好别动，泥沼里我更快。
lines.en: Best not move; I am faster in the mire.
I bite down and drag it into the water.

lines.zh: 我用下巴把它按进泥里。
lines.en: I press it into the mud with my snout.
I swallow it without chewing.

lines.zh: 沼泽的鳄，牙上挂着唱片。
lines.en: A swamp gator with a disc in its teeth.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的都不算浪费。
lines.en: Nothing on the ground goes to waste.
This is not a mouthful.
I hide it under the waterweed.
I pick it up, mud and all.
Your thing; I will keep it safe.
One snap of my jaws and it is gone.
I have my eye on that one.
You are the only living thing on the bank.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬起上半身，泥往下淌。
lines.en: I lift my forebody from the mud, muck running off.
I choose this one on the bank.

lines.zh: 你离岸够近了，我能扑到。
lines.en: You're close enough to the bank for me to lunge.
I begin crawling toward you.
I have locked onto your warmth.

lines.zh: 目标就是从水里能看到的那块。
lines.en: The target is what I can see from the water.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，牙上挂着沼泽的水草。
lines.en: I open my jaws, marshweed caught in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站的那块泥地，我记住了。
lines.en: I've marked the mudbank you stand on.
I come closer out of the water, bit by bit.
Even swamp gator teeth wear down.
I follow you along the bank.
I sink until only my eyes show.
You cannot move fast in this mud.

lines.zh: 我一直在你侧面的水里。
lines.en: I stay in the water to your side.
You stop, I stop, and the mud still moves.

lines.zh: 我拖着泥上岸，水先荡开。
lines.en: I haul myself ashore, and the water ripples first.

lines.zh: 你转身找，水面上只有圈。
lines.en: You turn to look and there are only ripples.
I wait for you to reach the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的牙合上了，没咬到骨。
lines.en: My jaws close and find no bone.

lines.zh: 我的牙扣住你的小腿，往泥里拖。
lines.en: My teeth clamp your calf and drag toward the mud.
One twist of my head flings you off.
That blow came with mud and water.
I whip your knee with my tail.
I hold and drag you toward the water.

lines.zh: 我的牙参差不齐，伤口很乱。
lines.en: My teeth are uneven and the wound is ragged.
You are knocked down into the mud.
I pin you down, and I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我整个身子翻起来，压在咬口上。
lines.en: I throw my whole body onto the bite.
The water bulges suddenly.

lines.zh: 我从泥里浮出来，带着泡。
lines.en: I surface from the mud with bubbles.
You see two eyes first.

lines.zh: 沼泽里多了一段会动的木头。
lines.en: The swamp has gained a log that moves.
I climb onto the bank, water running off my back.
The reeds part; I went through.

lines.zh: 我从深水里慢慢浮上来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the deep water.

lines.zh: 泥浆翻了一下，我就在那儿。
lines.en: The mud churns, and there I am.
The moment I appear, the frogs stop.

lines.zh: 我的背露出水面一点点。
lines.en: A little of my back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，我滚进泥里。
lines.en: Fire scorches my back and I roll into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下，砸出一片泥浆。
lines.en: I fall from the bank and smash into the mud.
I thrash in the water and sink deeper.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水面掀起来，我被抛出去。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and throws me clear.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的背上，没穿透。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back without piercing through.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的动作慢了一拍。
lines.en: A spell lands and my movement lags a beat.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃东西，我懒得动。
lines.en: Days without food, and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我缩进泥里。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I shrink into the mud.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拽出水面，我乱咬。
lines.en: The void hauls me out of the water and I snap wildly.
